name: Tabs
looksLike: row of labels that switch the content below
one highlighted label above a changing panel
click a heading to swap between views
definition: A row of controls that switches between related panels, showing one panel at a time without leaving the page.
whenToUse: Different views of the same information

notConfusedWith.difference: Expands sections in place and can show several sections at once.

prompts.short: Add tabs that show one panel at a time and support arrow-key navigation.
prompts.detailed: Add labeled tabs with one visible panel. Support arrow keys, Home and End, expose the selected tab, connect each tab to its panel, and keep a visible focus ring. Use 44px targets and allow the row to wrap on narrow screens.

reactTailwind: // Requires the shadcn/ui tabs component in the consuming project.
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
vue: const tabs = [{ title: "Overview", text: "Project summary." }, { title: "Activity", text: "Recent changes." }];
const next = { ArrowRight: (index + 1) % tabs.length, ArrowLeft: (index + tabs.length - 1) % tabs.length, Home: 0, End: tabs.length - 1 }[event.key];
<button v-for="(tab, i) in tabs" :id="`${uid}-tab-${i}`" :key="tab.title" type="button" role="tab"
<section v-for="(tab, i) in tabs" :id="`${uid}-panel-${i}`" :key="tab.title" v-show="active === i"
a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }

a11yNotes: Label the tab list and associate tabs with panels
Support arrow keys, Home and End
Expose selected state and keep keyboard focus visible
